role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 帕克脑海中有很多跟敌人开玩笑的恶作剧，它也因此天生就拥有将敌人搅得莫名其妙的本事。它可以传送到伤人的光球身上进行短距离跳跃，挥洒大量粉尘将敌人沉默。还没等敌人开始反应，帕克早已逃之夭夭。
hero_summary_en: Puck has a talent for confounding its enemies with playfully elusive mischief. By teleporting to its damaging orb in order to hop short distances, it attacks foes with bursts of silencing dust. By the time its enemies can react, Puck has long since escaped.

abilities.name: puck_illusory_orb
abilities.description_zh:
以矢量为目标。帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。法球每%damage_interval%秒会在作用范围内额外造成%damage_over_time_pct%%%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。

在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
abilities.description_en:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt. Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
notes_zh: 幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。
notes_en: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

abilities.name: puck_waning_rift
abilities.description_zh: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和沉默。
abilities.description_en: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
facet_text_en: Waning Rift pushes enemies away. If the ability is in alt-cast state, it will pull them instead.
facet_text_zh: 新月之痕会把敌人推开。如果技能设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），会把他们拉近。

abilities.name: puck_phase_shift
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕克暂时将自己转移到另一个位面，从而免疫伤害。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
notes_zh: 帕克在相位转移状态下依然具有碰撞体积。
进行任何动作都会中止相位转移。
帕克在相位转移状态下无敌。
notes_en: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.

shard_loc.en: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.
shard_loc.zh: 帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

abilities.name: puck_puckish
abilities.description_zh: 每当帕克躲避攻击时，它就会分别回复最大生命值和最大魔法值的%mana_and_health_restore_pct%%%。躲避指向性技能的弹道将回复%dodged_spell_multiplier%倍数值。防御塔的攻击不会对此生效。
abilities.description_en: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores %mana_and_health_restore_pct%%% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores %dodged_spell_multiplier%x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

abilities.name: puck_dream_coil
abilities.description_zh: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和束缚。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到眩晕和额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.

scepter_loc.en: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
scepter_loc.zh: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被眩晕时攻击也会继续。
